svg.title: ~/fun — a diffusion run
svg.desc: A terminal runs a fake diffusion model that denoises a halftone print of a figure in a dark coat, hair blown back, against a blue sky.

g.text: diffuse --prompt "me, mid-deploy, wind in my hair" --steps 50 --seed 42
sampler ddim · cfg 7.5 · 576×380 · fp16 · no gpus were harmed
